card.name: Allergic and anaphylactic reaction headings
card.fires_on: The ending of allergy words such as Allergic, Anaphylactic and Hypersensitivity, mostly in section headings like "5.7 Anaphylactic Reactions" in drug labels.

modes.label: Heading end of allergy term
modes.description: The last piece of Allergic or Anaphylactic in a numbered warnings heading, just before the word Reactions.
modes.example: 5.7 Anaphyl<<actic>> Reactions Fenoprofen has been associated

modes.label: Allergic in running text
modes.description: The word allergic or hypersensitivity inside a sentence or cross-reference about allergy-type reactions.
